# descope_mailjet_connector (Resource)

Manages a Mailjet connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Send emails through the Mailjet email delivery service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Mailjet API key used to authenticate requests, found under Account settings / API Key Management.
- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The secret key that pairs with the API key. Mailjet requires both to authenticate.
- `sender_email` (String) The email address that emails are sent from. Make sure it is a verified sender in Mailjet.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `sender_name` (String) The name shown as the sender of the emails.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
